reason: Full independent review verified the pinned raw SHA-256, all five exact quotes and locations, the Android-terminal concept route, and both fixed-query answers. The candidate preserves the signed-APK, role, Customer Area and Management API, Ready-versus-installed, certificate, version limit, automatic deletion, live-rate-limit, hardware, environment, and third-party liability boundaries. One retained action claim is broader than this raw: the Overview says subsequent installation or removal uses terminal-action API requests, profiles, or Customer Area scheduling. The raw offers those three routes for installation (line 23), but mentions uninstalling only through the API scheduling link for the returned app or certificate id (lines 255-256 and 443-444). A reader asking how to remove an uploaded app or certificate could be sent to profiles or Customer Area without evidence that either handles removal.
required_changes: Narrow the Overview route to say installation follows upload and can use API calls, profiles, or Customer Area scheduling. If mentioning removal, state only that the returned app or certificate id is used for API scheduling of uninstall, as supported by the pinned raw; do not imply that profiles or Customer Area support removal from this source. The two fixed answers and proposed Android-terminal reciprocal are otherwise sound.
